subject: Supplier portal session cookie binding failure - HollowTree onboarding
messages:
From: Amelie Dupont <amelie@hollowtree.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trouble accepting supplier portal invite (session cookie binding)

Hi Sergio,

We received the Coupa invite this morning but are unable to complete account creation. After clicking the invite link we immediately see a 302 redirect back to the corporate SSO and then Coupa returns us to the invite page with an error: "Session token mismatch / cookie binding failure". The flow only repeats. We tried with Chrome (latest) and Edge on a company-managed laptop, and the same loop happens.

Notes:
- We cannot use personal devices due to company policy (MDM required).
- IT is reluctant to disable cookie hardening.
- Attached is a screenshot of the console and the network redirect showing the 302 chain.

Can you re-issue an invite or provide a one-time, token-bound link that bypasses the cookie-binding check? Our onboarding is blocked because we need to submit W-9 and bank details to trigger the first PO.

Thanks,
Amelie
Amelie Dupont
Vendor Onboarding Lead, HollowTree Logistics
amelie@hollowtree.com
Attachment: screenshot-session-cookie.png

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Amelie Dupont <amelie@hollowtree.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 May 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier portal invite (session cookie binding)

Hi Amelie —

Thanks for the details and the screenshot, that helps. Sorry for the friction. A couple quick asks while I dig into platform-side options:

1) Can you try the invite in an Incognito window and confirm whether the 302 loop still happens? That will help isolate whether an existing session cookie is being re-used.
2) Please confirm the hostname you land on after SSO; if your corporate proxy rewrites the Host header we’ve seen token binding fail.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- I’ve CC'd Ben (Platform Ops) and Laura (Procurement) to get an expedited work item.
- We can either: (A) generate a one-time invite token that forces a fresh session on the Coupa tenant, or (B) create a temporary supplier record and invite you to set credentials via a different callback URL. Option A is faster if we can make the token ignore existing cookie-binding for one acceptance.

If you can send the HollowTree employee list for the initial upload (first name / last name / email) I’ll attach it as a temporary import so the PO can be routed while we resolve the invite loop. You can send the list back to me or attach to this thread.

I’ll follow up within 2 hours after I talk to Platform Ops.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Strategic Procurement Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Amelie Dupont <amelie@hollowtree.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier portal invite (session cookie binding)

Hi Sergio —

Tried Incognito, same behavior. Our network team captured headers and confirmed the Host header is rewritten to hn-proxy.hollowtree.corp at the perimeter; the original coupa host remains in the URL but the header is proxied. They flagged this as deliberate (security routing), so they can't change it for onboarding windows.

I've attached a sanitized employee CSV for the initial upload. We also attached the screenshot showing the 302s earlier.

If you can create a temporary supplier record on your side and share a direct credentials-setup link (not relying on our SSO redirect) that would be much appreciated. We understand this is an exception and it can be removed after onboarding.

Thanks — attaching: HollowTree_Employee_List.csv and screenshot-session-cookie.png

Best,
Amelie
HollowTree Logistics
Attachment: HollowTree_Employee_List.csv
Attachment: screenshot-session-cookie.png

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelie Dupont <amelie@hollowtree.com>
Date: Fri, 12 May 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: ACTION: generate temporary supplier record + bypass invite flow for HollowTree (inc. ticket link)

Ben / Laura —

Summary: HollowTree's perimeter proxies are rewriting Host headers which breaks Coupa's session token binding on our invite callback. They cannot change the proxy for security reasons. HollowTree needs a temporary way to accept onboarding assets so POs can be issued this week.

Requested actions (priority):
- Platform Ops (Ben): please create a temporary supplier record in the HollowTree tenant and generate a credentials-setup link that uses our alternate callback endpoint (/invite/no-cookie) which bypasses token-binding for single-use tokens. See support ticket INC-78821. Timebox: 4 business hours.
- Procurement (Laura): confirm we can manually route the initial PO to the temporary supplier profile as soon as Ben confirms the record exists.

If Ops cannot expose the alternate endpoint we should fall back to creating a short-lived shared credentials (SFTP drop for W-9 + bank) and mark the vendor as "pending portal" in Coupa. That is less ideal for the customer experience.

Amelie — I’ll share the generated link as soon as Ben returns confirmation to this thread. Thanks for the quick responses and the CSV — it will speed things up.

Sergio
-- End of thread --
